objective: Turn Alpha→Omega into a commercially viable service-enabled platform before promoting self-service SaaS
execution_rule: Execute and promote stages in dependency order. Technical reference-provider proof may advance implementation, but market, payment, cloud, customer and legal claims require fresh external evidence.

stages.name: Commercial Product Definition
stages.maturity_gate: offer catalogue, ICP, pricing and sales assets pass deterministic contract tests; external demand remains unproven

stages.name: Tenant and Identity Foundation
stages.maturity_gate: tenant isolation, RBAC, hash-chained audit and data-boundary tests

stages.name: Secrets and Provider Authority
stages.maturity_gate: secret-reference contract and rotation semantics verified; live secret provider proof required

stages.name: Customer Onboarding and Workspace Provisioning
stages.maturity_gate: idempotent local reference workspace creation, receipt, rollback and restore verified; live customer provider required

stages.name: Billing, Metering and Cost Governance
stages.maturity_gate: usage ledger, plan enforcement, invoice-ready export and budget controls verified; no invoice or payment claim

stages.name: Managed Operations and SLA Fabric
stages.maturity_gate: reference health, incident, backup, restore and SLA proof passes; production service proof required

stages.name: Provider Adapter Expansion
stages.maturity_gate: filesystem, SQLite and deterministic archive adapters pass deploy, readback, health, persistence and rollback; external provider breadth remains open

stages.name: Solution Catalogue and Capability Marketplace
stages.maturity_gate: immutable releases, lineage, tenant entitlement and licensing controls verified; no marketplace sale claimed

stages.name: Partner and White-Label Programme
stages.maturity_gate: partner tenant, branding, draft licence and revenue-share calculation verified; partner contract and adoption required

stages.name: Security, Privacy and Enterprise Assurance
stages.maturity_gate: security pack, privacy controls, retention, DR and enterprise audit evidence

stages.name: Customer Portal and Self-Service SaaS
stages.maturity_gate: customer-facing portal, subscription, provisioning and lifecycle management

stages.name: Case Studies and Commercial Proof
stages.maturity_gate: verified savings, time reduction, reliability and customer outcome evidence

stages.name: Sales and Revenue Operations
stages.maturity_gate: lead funnel, quoting, contract, renewal and revenue dashboards

stages.name: Scale, Reliability and Unit Economics
stages.maturity_gate: load, margin, support burden, churn and recovery targets proven

stages.name: Commercial Maturity and Succession
stages.maturity_gate: repeatable acquisition, delivery, recurring revenue, governance and succession drill
